title: London Bridge Is Falling Down with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to London Bridge Is Falling Down with Lulu the little duck! Lulu builds a bridge of toy blocks. The top blocks tumble softly onto the grass, and Lulu and her friends build it up again.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 1744).
